investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Cluster Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected as Unschedulable: the 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource reported Insufficient capacity, and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the agent pod never left the pending state.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents Swarm runtime has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry it, and the other 4 nodes are excluded by the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0 of 6 nodes available and preemption unable to free capacity, every remote-agent pod is stuck Unschedulable. This is an infrastructure-layer scheduling constraint, not an application code defect. The failure is localized to the production-api remote-agents runtime; no evidence of a broader service outage or user-traffic impact is present in the supplied packet.

investigation.title: published-observability-snapshot Eval Failure: Stale Snapshot (snapshotAgeMinutes=706, max=300)
investigation.summary: The AURA observability eval for `published-observability-snapshot` failed because the published snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json is 706 minutes old, exceeding the contract maximum of 300 minutes. All other public-website sibling checks passed, isolating the failure to the snapshot freshness assertion on this single endpoint. This is an eval-layer failure reflecting a stale published artifact; no evidence of a user-traffic or production incident is present in the packet.
investigation.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully within the required 300-minute window. The snapshot is 706 minutes old at eval time (2026-08-14T12:37:40Z), meaning the last successful publish occurred approximately 11 hours and 46 minutes before the eval ran. The contract defined in `infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json` (line 482) requires `snapshotAgeMinutes` to be at most 300; the observed value of 706 violates this assertion. The snapshot content itself is structurally valid (all other assertions pass), so the failure is isolated to workflow scheduling or execution, not to snapshot schema or data quality.

With 0 of 6 nodes available and preemption unable to free capacity, every remote-agent pod is stuck Unschedulable.
